source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 9: if a + b + c = 0 then a x b = b x c = c x a (book p.283); condition printed with garbled symbols. Proof, no key answer.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek vector equation di gayi hai aur us se natija nikalna hai.
Dikhana hai ke teen cross products barabar hain.
Plan: di hui equation ko pehle \(\underline{a}\) se, phir \(\underline{b}\) se cross karein aur simplify karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{c} \times \underline{a}\).
Tareeqa: Kisi equation ke dono taraf ek hi vector se (ek hi taraf se) cross karein to equation sahi rehti hai, jaise dono taraf ek hi number se multiply karna. Phir yeh rules: \(\underline{x} \times \underline{x} = \underline{0}\), \(\underline{x} \times \underline{0} = \underline{0}\), distributive law, aur \(\underline{x} \times \underline{y} = -\underline{y} \times \underline{x}\).
Geometry mein matlab: \(\underline{a}, \underline{b}, \underline{c}\) ek triangle ki sides hain (sir se dum mila kar), aur yeh teenon products us triangle ke area ka dugna, ek hi rukh mein.

Baayen taraf se \(\underline{a}\) ke saath cross karein
\[\underline{a} \times (\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c}) = \underline{a} \times \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{a} + \underline{a} \times \underline{b} + \underline{a} \times \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{0} + \underline{a} \times \underline{b} - \underline{c} \times \underline{a} = \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{c} \times \underline{a} \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Bracket distributive law se khula. \(\underline{a} \times \underline{a} = \underline{0}\) kyunke apne aap se angle 0 hai aur \(\sin 0 = 0\). \(\underline{a} \times \underline{c}\) ko \(-\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\) likha taake sawal wali shakal mil jaye. Phir \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\) ko doosri taraf le gaye.

Baayen taraf se \(\underline{b}\) ke saath cross karein
\[\underline{b} \times (\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c}) = \underline{b} \times \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{a} + \underline{b} \times \underline{b} + \underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
\[-\underline{a} \times \underline{b} + \underline{0} + \underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{b} \times \underline{c} \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Bilkul wohi kaam: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{b} = \underline{0}\) aur \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = -\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\). \(-\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) ko doosri taraf le jane se \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{b} \times \underline{c}\).
Dhyan dein: Har jagah \(\underline{b}\) ko baayen (left) taraf hi rakhein; ek taraf left aur doosri taraf right se cross karna ghalat hai.

(1) aur (2) ko milayein
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{c} \times \underline{a}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{c}\) bhi \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) ke barabar aur \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\) bhi, to teenon aapas mein barabar.

Misaal se tasdeeq
\[\underline{a} = \underline{i},\ \underline{b} = \underline{j},\ \underline{c} = -\underline{i} - \underline{j}\]
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{k}\]
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{c} = -\underline{j} \times \underline{i} = \underline{k}\]
\[\underline{c} \times \underline{a} = -\underline{j} \times \underline{i} = \underline{k}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) hai aur teenon products \(\underline{k}\) aaye. \(\underline{j} \times \underline{j} = \underline{0}\) aur \(\underline{i} \times \underline{i} = \underline{0}\) wale terms gir gaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Question 9 ki shart (condition) kitab mein bigde hue nishaanon ke saath chhapi hai (\(\underline{c}\) aur plus ke signs toote hue hain). Sahi shart \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) hai.
